revision.reason: Align with existing books/covers and books/previews, separate publication figures from branding, and correct SVG/WebP format policy.

ICON.rule: Keep vector; do not convert to WebP.

FIGURE.rule: Native vector diagrams use SVG; rich/raster and existing publication figures remain WebP.

INSTRUCTION.rule: Simple instructional diagrams use SVG; rich/raster instruction artwork may use WebP; long copy remains HTML.

BRANDING.rule: Raster identity uses WebP; vector marks use SVG. Canonical book covers remain under books/covers.

objectClassBoundary.books/covers: Canonical book cover and 3D hardcover objects.
objectClassBoundary.images/branding: Reusable visual identity only; not publication figure storage and not duplicate cover storage.
objectClassBoundary.images/figures/books: Figures originating from Book 1–5 publication content.
objectClassBoundary.images/instructions: Instructional visual aids; long instructional copy remains HTML.
